data.description:
Update post-functions.sh to read dso.workflow=ci-pr instead of attribution.enabled=true.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/post-functions.sh
- tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh

## Implementation Change in post-functions.sh
Current code (line 404):
  _enabled=$(bash "$_rc_script" attribution.enabled 2>/dev/null) || _enabled=""
  
Replace with:
  _wf=$(bash "$_rc_script" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || echo "local")
  [[ "$_wf" == "ci-pr" ]] && _enabled="true" || _enabled="false"

The semantic mapping: attribution.enabled=true → dso.workflow=ci-pr. Attribution is enabled when running in CI-PR workflow mode.

## All references to update
- Line 404: functional read of attribution.enabled → replace with dso.workflow read
- Lines 397, 433, 482, 487: comment references to "attribution.enabled" → update comment text to reference dso.workflow

## Test Updates (must FAIL before implementation)
In tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh: update configs from attribution.enabled=true/false to dso.workflow=ci-pr/local

## Story DD Coverage
This task contributes to DD1 (zero grep matches for attribution.enabled in hook files)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh
- [ ] No functional reference to attribution.enabled remains in post-functions.sh
  Verify: ! grep -q 'bash.*attribution\.enabled\|attribution\.enabled.*bash' plugins/dso/hooks/lib/post-functions.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
